conditions.warm: 3 excluded warmups then 31 repeated owner create/allocate/release samples in one process; Android remaps every time; Windows pool retained
conditions.cold: Each allocation sample in a fresh process; filesystem cache/CPU frequency/thermal state uncontrolled, not storage-cold
conditions.decode: Separate fresh processes, path streaming, one decoded vector; no zone allocation; checksum/full end/length validated
conditions.allocator: Only 36 bytes extracted by successful genuine decode; no decoded payload remains in allocation processes
conditions.timing: Monotonic CLOCK_MONOTONIC/QPC; /proc/PSAPI reads excluded; concurrent 1ms resident sampler enabled
conditions.quantiles: median (average middle pair if even); p95 nearest rank ceil(0.95*N)
conditions.memory: HWM is process-lifetime cumulative. Sampler may miss sub-ms peaks. Android mprotect accessible bytes are not physical commitment; Windows private commit/working set are distinct metrics.
